visualCharacteristics.purpose: Employee interview layout: intro and Q/A boxes beside a portrait image

contentPattern.structure: Each row: [text cell: intro paragraph, then paragraphs starting with "Q:" and "A:"] [image cell]. Q:/A: paragraphs (plus following paragraphs) are wrapped into question/answer boxes

usage: Employee interview layout: intro and Q/A boxes beside a portrait image.

notSuitableFor: FAQs without an image (use an accordion)
